impacts.text: The dynamic fee system contains a cconflicting fee caps between `DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()` and `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` which renders the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective.
causing the system to always fall back to basic tick spacing fees
any dynamically calculated fee above 10% gets rejected reducing potential protocol revenue
Potential user discounts applied in `getFee()` are lost when the factory rejects the final fee.
the 50% anti-MEV protection cap becomes unusable, leaving pools vulnerable to maximal extractable value attacks during high volatility
